description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Cost and Reliability Score for three different models, comparing their performance across varying costs. The x-axis is labeled "Cost", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 10, and has tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Reliability Score", has a linear scale, ranges from 30 to 90, and has tick labels at intervals of 20. The 3-Model Ensemble is represented by a blue line with circle markers, solid style, starting at a Reliability Score of approximately 84 at a Cost of 0, decreasing steadily to around 72 at a Cost of 10. The 2-Model Ensemble is depicted by a red line with circle markers, solid style, beginning at a Reliability Score of about 88 at a Cost of 0, and declining to roughly 71 at a Cost of 10. The GPT-4 model is shown as a yellow line with circle markers, solid style, starting at a Reliability Score of approximately 92 at a Cost of 0, and dropping sharply to around 40 at a Cost of 10.
